position.description: Comma separated passage tile positional coordinates (e.g. "600,400").

SpecialTag.description: Special tags with special meaning to all Twee 3 compilers (not exhaustive).

start.description: Optional. Maps to <tw-passagedata name> of the start node.

description: Twee 3 Specification v3.0.2: Twee files are composed of one or more passages; passages consist of a header and content section.

content.description: The content section, from the line after the header to the next passage header or end of file.

tags.description: Optional tag block: a space separated list of tag names; tags must not contain spaces.
